text:
sam: Alert from logs: KMS-wrapped ciphertexts leaked to stdout from one ingest pod during a deploy window. low volume but definitely P1. snippet below.

sam: ```
2025-08-02T09:11:02Z INFO ingest: put blob id=blk_A12 wrap_ct=CiAb...
2025-08-02T09:11:03Z INFO ingest: put blob id=blk_A13 wrap_ct=CiAb...
```

eva: Which key was used? any partner SA involved?

cesar: Looks like projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-wrap (v5). partner onboarding serviceAccount partner-onboard@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com had encrypter granted briefly.

security-bot: IAM: partner-onboard@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com called cloudkms.encrypt on ingest-wrap at 2025-08-02T09:11:04Z.

vaultd: Vault namespace "ingest" audit shows writes for wrap metadata at 2025-08-02T09:10-09:12. retention currently 30d. recommend bump to 90d for this namespace.

sam: Immediate plan I propose: revoke encrypter for partner SA, create new wrap key (ingest-wrap-rot1), export a hitlist of blobs created in the window, dual-wrap support for 48h, bulk rewrap in controlled batches, rotate any exposed consumer tokens and CI keys, block hostPath / keystore mounts via admission policy.

eva: Agreed. I'll revoke the IAM binding and push a TF change to remove encrypter. snippet: 

  ```hcl
  resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member" "rm_partner_encrypter" {
    crypto_key_id = var.ingest_key
    role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
    member = "serviceAccount:partner-onboard@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  }
  ```

cesar: I'll own rewrap. plan: generate hitlist from storage logs -> gs://redwood-sec/hitlists/ingest-20250802.json (restricted), dry-run in staging, then prod batches of 100. sample cmd: 

  ```bash
  python infra/rewrap.py \
    --hitlist gs://redwood-sec/hitlists/ingest-20250802.json \
    --src projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap \
    --dst projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap-rot1 \
    --batch 100 --verify --dry-run
  ```

oncall: I'll schedule a 30m deploy freeze and monitor metrics. if rewrap causes >0.2% decrypt errors we abort and roll back.

sam: Also: bump Vault audit retention for ingest -> 90d and add alert: wrap_calls_by_sa > 5/min => pager. @vaultd can you update config?

vaultd: Will add retention change and transient alert. PR link after push.

security-bot: Ticket opened SEC-2210 "ingest log exposure of wrapped ciphertexts: rewrap + RBAC + admission policy". assignees: cesar, eva, sam. priority P1.

eva: After rewrap, rotate long-lived consumer tokens + CI runners that accessed the affected buckets. revoke old wrap key versions after 72h with a verification sweep.

sam: Good. Capture post-run checklist here when done: hitlist path, batches processed, errors, rotated secrets list, policy PRs, Vault PRs. We'll run a brief postmortem in 48h and add an onboarding rule: no hostPath, use Vault/KMS provider only.

cesar: Starting staging dry-run now, will post results in thread.
